C_tab_safety.note: Saved warning information from the Matatiele system.
C_tab_safety.text:
WHAT TO DO: BE PREPARED
Lightning: Know which solid building you would go to if you hear thunder.
Flooding: Know the higher ground near your home, and keep children away from streams.
Roads: Plan travel early. Avoid roads that flood or cross low bridges.
Rivers: Avoid crossing rivers later in the day; water can rise quickly after storms upstream.
Livestock: Plan where animals can shelter away from rivers, lone trees and wire fences.
IF A STORM COMES
Lightning: if you hear thunder, go inside a solid building or a closed car.
Flooding: never walk or drive through flood water; move to higher ground.
Roads: do not cross flooded roads, low bridges or causeways.
Rivers: stay away from rivers and streams; they can rise suddenly.
Livestock: move animals early; do not go out once lightning starts.
EMERGENCY NUMBERS
